arxiv-2101-08126.title: A short proof on the rate of convergence of the empirical measure for the Wasserstein distance
arxiv-2101-08126.creator: Vincent Divol
arxiv-2101-08126.description: Abstract We provide a short proof that the Wasserstein distance between the empirical measure of a n n -sample and the estimated measure is of order n − 1 / d n^{-1/d} , if the measure has a lower and upper bounded density on the d d -dimensional flat torus.

arxiv-2209-10982.title: Long-time behaviour of solutions to a nonlinear system of fluid-structure interaction Thanks: Michelle Luckas would like to thank the “Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes” for academic and financial support. The authors would like to thank Dorothee Knees and Matthias Eller for helpful discussions a
arxiv-2209-10982.creator: Karoline Disser, Michelle Luckas
arxiv-2209-10982.description: Abstract . We consider a non-linear system modelling the dynamics of a linearly elastic body immersed in an incompressible viscous fluid. We prove local existence of strong solutions and global existence and uniqueness for small data. The main result is the characterization of long-time behaviour of the elastic displacement.

arxiv-2301-10132.title: The superadditivity effects of quantum capacity decrease with the dimension for qudit depolarizing channels
arxiv-2301-10132.creator: Josu Etxezarreta Martinez, Antonio deMarti iOlius, Pedro M. Crespo
arxiv-2301-10132.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Josu Etxezarreta Martinez, Antonio deMarti iOlius, Pedro M. Crespo. Quantum channel capacity is a fundamental quantity in order to understand how good can quantum information be transmitted or corrected when subjected to noise. However, it is generally not known how to compute such quantities, since the quantum channel coherent information is not additive for all channels, implying that it must be maximized over an unbounded number of channel uses.

arxiv-2307-13034.title: A Comparison of the Composition of Planets in Single- and Multi-Planet Systems Orbiting M dwarfs
arxiv-2307-13034.creator: Romy Rodríguez Martínez, David V. Martin, B. Scott Gaudi, Joseph G. Schulze, Anusha Pai Asnodkar, Kiersten M. Boley, Sarah Ballard
arxiv-2307-13034.description: Abstract We investigate and compare the composition of M-dwarf planets in systems with only one known planet (“singles”) to those residing in multi-planet systems (“multis”) and the fundamental properties of their host stars. We restrict our analysis to planets with directly measured masses and radii, which comprise a total of 70 planets: 30 singles and 40 multis in 19 systems.

arxiv-2403-12885.title: Improved decay results for micropolar flows with nonlinear damping Thanks: C. F. Perusato was partially supported by Cnpq through grant # \# 310444/2022 - 5, bolsa PQ
arxiv-2403-12885.creator: Cilon F. Perusato, Franco D. Vega
arxiv-2403-12885.description: Abstract . We examine the long-time behavior of solutions (and their derivatives) to the micropolar equations with nonlinear velocity damping. Additionally, we get a speed-up gain of t 1 / 2 t^{1/2} for the angular velocity, consistent with established findings for classic micropolar flows lacking nonlinear damping.

arxiv-2409-19590.title: RoboNurse-VLA: Robotic Scrub Nurse System based on Vision-Language-Action Model

arxiv-2409-19590.description: Abstract In modern healthcare, the demand for autonomous robotic assistants has grown significantly, particularly in the operating room, where surgical tasks require precision and reliability. Robotic scrub nurses have emerged as a promising solution to improve efficiency and reduce human error during surgery.

arxiv-2411-07600.title: Decision Feedback In-Context Symbol Detection over Block-Fading Channels
arxiv-2411-07600.creator: Li Fan, Jing Yang, Cong Shen
arxiv-2411-07600.description: Abstract Pre-trained Transformers, through in-context learning (ICL), have demonstrated exceptional capabilities to adapt to new tasks using example prompts without model update . Transformer-based wireless receivers, where prompts consist of the pilot data in the form of transmitted and received signal pairs, have shown high estimation accuracy when pilot data are abundant.

arxiv-2502-01210.title: Phonetic accommodation and inhibition in a dynamic neural field model
arxiv-2502-01210.creator: Sam Kirkham (s.kirkham@lancaster.ac.uk), Patrycja Strycharczuk (patrycja.strycharczuk@manchester.ac.uk), Rob Davies (r.l.davies@lancaster.ac.uk), Danielle Welburn (dani_welburn@hotmail.com)
arxiv-2502-01210.description: Abstract Short-term phonetic accommodation is a fundamental driver behind accent change, but how does real-time input from another speaker’s voice shape the speech planning representations of an interlocutor? We advance a computational model of change in speech planning representations during phonetic accommodation, grounded in dynamic neural field equations for movement planning and memory dynamics.

arxiv-2602-02421.description: Abstract The large observational dataset currently available has revealed our ignorance regarding angular momentum redistribution during the stars’ life. pmc-12587225.title: Obesity is associated with increased brain glucose uptake and activity but not neuroinflammation (TSPO availability) in monozygotic twin pairs discordant for BMI—Exercise training reverses increased brain activity

pmc-12587225.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). AimsObesity is associated with increased insulin‐stimulated brain glucose uptake (BGU) which is opposite to decreased GU observed in peripheral tissues. Increased BGU was shown to be reversed by weight loss and exercise training, but the mechanisms remain unknown.

pmc-13406484.title: Virtual Reality-Based Rehabilitation in Children and Adolescents with Muscular Dystrophy: A Systematic Review of Feasibility, Engagement, and Clinical Outcomes
pmc-13406484.creator: Insu Choi, Hwa Jin Cho, Song-Ai Kang, Won-Jae Kim, Min-Keun Song
pmc-13406484.description: Background/Objectives: Muscular dystrophies (MDs) are progressive neuromuscular disorders in which rehabilitation is central to management, yet conventional physical therapy in children is constrained by motivation, accessibility, and the need to adapt across disease stages. Virtual reality (VR) offers an interactive, adaptable, and home-deliverable alternative, but prior reviews focused narrowly on upper-limb outcomes in Duchenne muscular dystrophy or on motor-learning paradigms.

uslaw-usc-t36-s150704.title: 36 U.S.C. § 150704 — National officers
uslaw-usc-t36-s150704.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t36-s150704.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 1507 (National Conference On Citizenship). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) National Officers.— The national officers of the corporation are a president, a first vice president, a second vice president, a third vice president, a secretary, and a treasurer. The president is chairman of the board.
